Program Admissions Requirements
Important
Always visit program websites to learn about
program specific application requirements.
In addition to the general Laney Graduate School application requirements, many programs require items specific to their application. For example, many require a writing sample, many ask for specific information about your research experience or other qualifications, and some programs require GRE scores (general test). If you are an international applicant, you may need to submit TOEFL scores or a credential evaluation.
To reach program websites and learn about these requirements, go to our Degree Programs page, find the relevant program, and follow the link to their website. You will also see some information about requirements in our application for admission, once you have selected a program. But the best and most accurate source is always the program’s own website.
Note: If you are required to or decide to submit GRE, GMAT or TOEFL test scores, you will need to arrange for us to receive official score reports. Our institution code for all three is 5187 (no department code is needed).
